name: tinyactors-vscode
description: Experimental and internal: a Debug Adapter Protocol client for testing the Tinyactors debug adapters. Runs a workbench with the test host's adapter, or attaches to an actor in a running application

untrustedWorkspaces.description: A launch runs the adapter a workspace's configuration names.

tinyactors.dapPath.markdownDescription: The test host's debug adapter, `tinyactors-test/bin/dap`, for a `launch`. Empty: found in a workspace folder, or in a directory above the workbench. A relative path is relative to the workspace folder.

workbench.description: The directory of chart files to run as a workbench.

program.description: The same as "workbench", which wins when both are given.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop once every actor has started, before any event reaches one.

host.description: The tinyactors-test executable, when not the one beside the adapter.

dapPath.markdownDescription: The adapter, `tinyactors-test/bin/dap`. Default: the `tinyactors.dapPath` setting, else found in a workspace folder or above the workbench.

runtimeExecutable.markdownDescription: The Ruby 4 that runs the adapter, when the `ruby` on VS Code's `PATH` is not it, for example `~/.local/share/mise/installs/ruby/4/bin/ruby`.

port.description: The port the application serves debug sessions on.

host.description: The host the application serves debug sessions on.

address.markdownDescription: The actor to attach to, by its address: `"family/name"` or `{ "family": ..., "name": ... }`.

sessionID.description: The actor to attach to, by its session ID in decimal, when it has no address.

actor.description: The actor to attach to, by its actor ID.

enumDescriptions: Send events to the actor from the debug console.
Operator transitions: goto, abandon, cancel and replace.
Run expressions in the application's process: watch, hover, console and conditions.

allow.description: The permissions to ask for; none watches the actor only. The actor is never paused: it is watched live, and each permission is a way to poke it. Default, and at most: what the application's session grants.

configurationSnippets.label: Tinyactors: Launch a workbench
configurationSnippets.description: Run a directory of charts with the test host's adapter

configurationSnippets.label: Tinyactors: Attach to an actor
configurationSnippets.description: Connect to an application that serves debug sessions over TCP
